[b] Where flexible diaphragms provide lateral support for concrete or masonry walls and partitions, the design forces for anchorage to the diaphragm shall be as specified in Section 12.11.2.
[Eq. 13.3-1] Horizontal Seismic Design Force: Fp = 0.4 * SDS * Ip * Wp * (Hf / R_mu) * (C_AR / R_po).
[Eq. 13.3-2 & 13.3-3] Upper and Lower Limits: Fp_max = 1.6 * SDS * Ip * Wp; Fp_min = 0.3 * SDS * Ip * Wp.
[Eq. 13.3-5] Force Amplification Factor (where period Ta of supporting structure is unknown): Hf = 1 + 2.5 * (z / h). For components at or below grade plane, Hf = 1.0.

[Eq. 13.3-6] Structure Ductility Reduction Factor (above grade plane): R_mu = sqrt(1.1 * R / (Ie * Omega_0)) >= 1.3. Where supporting structure SFRS is unknown, R_mu = 1.3. At or below grade plane, R_mu = 1.0.
